ValidationRule.description: Validation to make fields in user information section mandatory on selection of type as User Maintenance
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type_1__c,'User Maintenance'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type_2__c,'New User (Full Salesforce Licence)'),ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type_2__c,'New User (Salesforce Chatter Licence))')), OR( ISBLANK(First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(Qantas_Staff__c), ISBLANK(User_s_Email__c), ISPICKVAL(Country__c,''), ISBLANK(Team_Position__c), ISBLANK(Reports_To__c) ), RecordType.DeveloperName == 'System_Admin_Request')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill all user information for user maintenance request.
